answer: Stop sybils with an umber relic sparrow: an agent bonds one relic case. Each cycle it flies one sparrow over its umber field; verifiers match the sparrow's umber flight path to the relic chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 relics at 18x: one sparrow flies once over one field, its path set by that relic alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents fly once, keep rights.
